protocol.purpose: Infrastructure retest, not training or statistical comparison
protocol.history: Empty isolated bank for each method; no feedback between methods
rules: One attempt per method, no paid retries
Identical public tests and limits; explicit uncalibrated priors
MetaACO uses feasible initialization within 100 total evaluations
Shared remaining monetary budget changes per-attempt policy and may change available models
Held costs carry forward; missing accounting stops remaining series
Direct correctness and TDD compliance are reported separately
Preflight plans use total budget; actual manifests record remaining-budget plans; no manual route substitution
